            <h1>Building the Portfolio</h1>
            <p class="article-subtitle">The work was never the work. I was.</p>
            <!-- NEW DEK -->
            <p class="article-dek">A quiet rebuild of my site, my systems, and the parts of my identity I used to outsource to a logo.</p>

            <div class="article-byline-row">
                <span>By Luis Gilberto</span>
                <span class="byline-sep">/</span>
                <span class="publish-date">Aug 2025</span>

            <div class="reading-content" id="portrait">
                <p class="lead">A portfolio is not a website. It is not a gallery of screenshots or a collection of deliverables. A portfolio is a portrait.</p>

                <!-- SIGNATURE PULL QUOTE -->
                <section class="pull-quote-block" aria-label="Signature pull quote">
                    <p class="pull-quote-kicker">Signature line</p>
                    <p class="pull-quote-text">I care about the idea, but I care even more about the delivery.</p>
                </section>

                <p>For a long time, I didn't understand that. I thought my value lived inside the company badge I wore. My identity was borrowed. It was defined by the places I worked, the logos I supported, the teams I belonged to.</p>
                
                <div class="inset-card">
                    <h4>The Shift</h4>
                    <p>Stepping away from that world felt like stepping off a moving train. Disorienting at first. Then quieter than I expected. That quiet gave me something I had not had in years, a blank page.</p>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="reading-content" id="badge">
                <h3>Leaving the Badge</h3>
                <p>The old version of my portfolio was functional and polite. It showed the work, but it hid the person behind it. So I asked one question that changed everything: how do I create a portfolio that feels alive?</p>
                
                <!-- INSIGHT MOMENT -->
                <div class="insight-moment">
                    <p class="insight-label">Insight</p>
                    <p class="insight-text"><strong>Logos can describe your work.</strong> They cannot describe your voice. The portfolio only starts working when the human shows up.</p>
                </div>

                <div class="visual-break">
                    <img src="/insights/assets/images/BTP_Decorative_break_1.png" alt="Identity Mask" style="border-radius: 4px;">
                    <p class="caption">Identity borrowed from the workplace.</p>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="reading-content" id="craft">
                <h3>Rebuilding the Site</h3>
                <p>I built toward a specific emotional tone: the feeling of walking through a city at night with headphones on. Quiet intensity. Soft confidence.</p>
                
                <!-- BUILD NOTES MODULE -->
                <div class="build-notes">
                    <p class="build-notes-label">Build notes</p>
                    <ul class="build-notes-list">
                        <li><strong>Typography</strong> Calm, clear, and confident. Headlines with presence, body text that feels warm.</li>
                        <li><strong>Color</strong> Black is home. Coral is the pulse. Negative space does half the work because clarity does not hurry.</li>
                        <li><strong>Motion</strong> Subtle, purposeful, and never frantic. A site should breathe.</li>
                    </ul>
                </div>

                <div class="quote-card">
                    <p class="large-quote">Reinvention is not redesign. It is repair.</p>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="reading-content" id="system">
                <h3>The Self Behind the System</h3>
                <p>This site represents a version of me that did not exist before. Someone self-defined, not job-defined. Someone who carries both triumphs and scars without sanding them down.</p>
                
                <div class="editorial-note">
                    <span class="editorial-label">Reflection</span>
                    <p class="editorial-text">
                        If you are building your own portfolio right now, stop trying to prove you are good enough. Start trying to show who you actually are.
                    </p>
                </div>
            </div>

        </article>
    </div>

    <!-- Safe Script Loading -->
    <script src="/insights/assets/js/article-interactions.js"></script>
    <script>
        // Inline safety check for drawer interaction if file fails
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const toggle = document.getElementById('mobileMenuToggle');
            const overlay = document.getElementById('mobileMenuOverlay');
            const close = document.getElementById('mobileMenuClose');
            if(toggle && overlay && close) {
                toggle.addEventListener('click', () => { overlay.classList.add('is-open'); document.body.style.overflow='hidden'; });
                close.addEventListener('click', () => { overlay.classList.remove('is-open'); document.body.style.overflow=''; });
            }
        });
    </script>
